name: com.titanpestpro/public-tools
title: Titan Pest Pro
description: Pest control facts by ZIP, price ranges and contact, plus free inspection and callback requests.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Returns the pest control services Titan Pest Pro offers in its Kansas City and Springfield service areas, the services it does not offer, and the published price range where Titan publishes one. Call this when the user asks what Titan treats, which plan fits a pest, what a service costs, or whether Titan handles a specific problem. Prices are public ranges; the exact price is confirmed at a free, no-obligation inspection. Optional input: category (plans, other, not_offered or all; default all). Returns a text summary plus structured items with id, name and the exact line to relay. It does not book anything or check an address; use check_service_area for a ZIP code.

category.description: Which group to return. Default all.

tools.name: check_service_area
tools.description: Checks one 5-digit US ZIP code against Titan Pest Pro's service-area list (154 ZIP codes in the Kansas City and Springfield areas of Missouri and Kansas). Call this before suggesting a free inspection, or whenever the user asks whether Titan serves their town or address; ask the user for the ZIP code of the property if you don't have it. Returns served true or false and, when served, the town, the market, the local location that covers it and that location's web page. It does not check dates or appointment openings.

zip.description: 5-digit US ZIP code of the property, for example 65807.

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: Returns how to reach Titan Pest Pro: the phone number to call, how calls and callbacks work, and the web page for requesting a free inspection. Call this when the user wants to call, talk to a person, or asks how to get in touch. Takes no input.

tools.name: get_trust_facts
tools.description: Returns Titan Pest Pro's published facts about itself: founding year, licence numbers and the licence holder, BBB rating, Google review rating and review counts per market, and the approved wording of its Free Re-Service Guarantee. Call this when the user asks about licences, insurance, reputation, reviews, or what is covered if pests return between visits. Relay these facts as given; do not round, combine or extend them. Takes no input.

tools.name: explain_free_inspection
tools.description: Explains Titan Pest Pro's free, no-obligation inspection: what happens, what it costs (nothing), which jobs are not free inspections (real-estate WDI/NPMA-33 inspections and dead animal removal), typical scheduling, the arrival call, and how to request one. Call this when the user asks how the inspection works, whether it is really free, how soon someone can come, or what happens after they ask for one. Takes no input.

tools.name: list_blog_posts
tools.description: Lists Titan Pest Pro's own blog posts about pests and pest control, from a checked list (guest and partner content is not included). Call this when the user wants Titan's advice on a pest topic. Optional query matches words in the post title; optional limit (1-20, default 10) and offset page through results. Returns post id, title, link and publish date, newest first. Use read_blog_post with an id to get a post's text.

query.description: Words to match in post titles, for example mice or termites. Optional.

limit.description: How many posts to return. Default 10.

offset.description: How many matching posts to skip. Default 0.

tools.name: request_free_inspection
tools.description: Sends a free inspection request to Titan Pest Pro's team for the user: the same request the form at titanpestpro.com/free-inspection/ sends. Use it only after the user has asked for a free inspection, has given you their phone number, the 5-digit ZIP code of the property, what they need help with and how urgent it is, and has said you may send it; name and email are optional. Only pass what the user actually told you. Do not use it for a real-estate WDI/termite letter or for dead animal removal (those are not free inspections; give the user the phone number instead). If the ZIP code is outside Titan's service area, nothing is sent. Returns a short status message.

phone.description: The user's 10-digit US phone number (digits, with or without dashes, dots, spaces, parentheses or a leading +1).

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP code of the property to be inspected.

need.description: What the user needs help with.

urgency.description: How urgent the user says it is.

name.description: The user's name, if they gave it. Optional.

email.description: The user's email, if they gave it. Optional.

tools.name: request_callback
tools.description: Asks Titan Pest Pro's team to call the user back. A Titan team member calls back during regular hours; this tool does not book a visit and does not look up any account. Use it only after the user has asked for a call back, has given you their 10-digit US phone number and a short reason, and has said you may send it; their name is optional. Only pass what the user actually told you. For anything urgent, give the user the phone number (888) 343-9939 instead: phones are answered around the clock. Returns a short status message.

phone.description: The user's 10-digit US phone number (digits, with or without dashes, dots, spaces, parentheses or a leading +1).

reason.description: In the user's words, briefly what the call is about (for example, ants in the kitchen). Plain text, up to 300 characters.

name.description: The user's name, if they gave it. Optional.

tools.name: ask_titan
tools.description: Answers one question about Titan Pest Pro's services, plans, process or policies with the company's own approved answer, word for word, from its checked Knowledge Catalog. Read-only. When no approved answer matches it says so and suggests get_contact or request_callback; it never writes a new answer. A price, when one appears, is a range confirmed at the free inspection.

question.description: The customer's question in plain words, for example: Do you treat for termites?
